ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #13 (TERM 1)
====

GRADE: Grade 4
SUBJECT: ARABIC LANGUAGE
TIME ALLOWED: 60 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
ASSESSMENT: CBC school-based practice paper

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show your working and write the units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the one best answer.
4. Check your work before you hand in.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. What is the correct reply to shukran (thank you)? (1 mark)
   A. marhaban
   B. maʿa s-salaama
   C. ismii
   D. ʿafwan

2. What does the Arabic word مَرْحَبًا (marhaban) mean? (1 mark)
   A. hello
   B. and upon you peace (the reply)
   C. I
   D. good morning (the reply)

3. Which Arabic sentence means "This is my father." (1 mark)
   A. أَبِي يَعْمَلُ
   B. هَذَا أَبِي
   C. هَذِهِ أُمِّي
   D. عِنْدِي أَخٌ وَأُخْتٌ

4. Which Arabic sentence means "My mother cooks." (1 mark)
   A. عِنْدِي أَخٌ وَأُخْتٌ
   B. هَذِهِ أُمِّي
   C. أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ
   D. هَذَا أَبِي

5. What does the Arabic word خَلْفَ (khalfa) mean? (1 mark)
   A. beside
   B. above
   C. under
   D. behind

6. What does the Arabic sentence هَذَا بَيْتِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. The lamp is above the table.
   B. This is my house.
   C. The cat is under the bed.
   D. The book is on the table.

7. What does the Arabic word اُكْتُبْ (uktub) mean? (1 mark)
   A. write
   B. close the door
   C. come in
   D. raise your hand

8. Which Arabic word means "sit down"? (1 mark)
   A. اجْلِسْ
   B. اِسْمَعْ
   C. اِقْرَأْ
   D. افْتَحِ الْبَابَ

9. What does the Arabic sentence كُلَّ عَامٍ وَأَنْتُمْ بِخَيْرٍ mean? (1 mark)
   A. Do you have a party? (to a boy)
   B. May you be well every year.
   C. Happy birthday.
   D. Blessed festival (Happy Eid).

10. What does hal do at the start of an Arabic question? (1 mark)
   A. It means 'my'
   B. It means 'and'
   C. It means 'the'
   D. It makes a yes or no question

11. Which word means 'I drink'? (1 mark)
   A. ashrabu
   B. aakulu
   C. uhibbu
   D. askunu

12. What does the Arabic sentence أَشْرَبُ الْحَلِيبَ mean? (1 mark)
   A. I drink milk.
   B. I eat bread.
   C. I drink water.
   D. I like bananas.

13. What does the Arabic sentence أَشُمُّ بِأَنْفِي mean? (1 mark)
   A. I smell with my nose.
   B. I see with my eye.
   C. I hear with my ear.
   D. I speak with my mouth.

14. Which sentence says 'I hear with my ear'? (1 mark)
   A. aktubu bi-yadii
   B. asmaʿu bi-udhunii
   C. ashummu bi-anfii
   D. araa biʿaynii

15. Which Arabic sentence means "I see with my eye." (1 mark)
   A. أَسْمَعُ بِأُذُنِي
   B. أَنَا أَرَى بِعَيْنِي
   C. أَتَكَلَّمُ بِفَمِي
   D. أَشُمُّ بِأَنْفِي

16. How is the Arabic word مُشْمِسٌ read aloud in English letters? (1 mark)
   A. shajara
   B. jabal
   C. jamiil
   D. mushmis

17. What does the Arabic word شَمْسٌ (shams) mean? (1 mark)
   A. weather
   B. flower
   C. sunny
   D. sun

18. What does the Arabic word بَارِدٌ (baarid) mean? (1 mark)
   A. rain
   B. weather
   C. cold
   D. hot

19. What does the Arabic sentence شُكْرًا لِاسْتِمَاعِكُمْ mean? (1 mark)
   A. Thank you for listening.
   B. Water is useful (good for you).
   C. In my house there is a kitchen.
   D. I am in Grade 4.

20. What does tone mean in public speaking? (1 mark)
   A. The length of the speech
   B. How your voice sounds, for example friendly and clear
   C. The size of the audience
   D. The colour of your clothes

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
21. Translate into English: azraʿu shajara (2 marks)

22. Explain why a speaker should practise before speaking to an audience. (2 marks) (2 marks)

23. Translate into English: anaa ʿinda l-baab (2 marks)

24. Give three rules for taking turns in a conversation. (3 marks) (3 marks)

25. Write five foods or drinks in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

26. Translate into English: atakallamu bi-famii (2 marks)

27. Translate into English: anaa bi-khayr, al-hamdu lillaah (2 marks)

28. Write three foods and two drinks in Arabic sounds with meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

29. Write five words about weather and the environment in Arabic (English letters are fine) with their meanings. (5 marks) (5 marks)

30. Explain how the voice should sound in a statement and in a question. (2 marks) (2 marks)
pages.answers:
ARABIC LANGUAGE — TERMLY EXAM #13 (TERM 1) · MARKING SCHEME
====

SECTION A
----
1. D — ʿafwan
   ʿafwan means 'you are welcome' and is the polite reply to thanks.

2. A — hello
   مَرْحَبًا (marhaban) means hello.

3. B — هَذَا أَبِي
   هَذَا أَبِي (haadhaa abii) means: This is my father.

4. C — أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ
   أُمِّي تَطْبُخُ (ummii tatbukhu) means: My mother cooks.

5. D — behind
   خَلْفَ (khalfa) means behind.

6. B — This is my house.
   هَذَا بَيْتِي (haadhaa baytii) means: This is my house.

7. A — write
   اُكْتُبْ (uktub) means write.

8. A — اجْلِسْ
   اجْلِسْ (ijlis) means sit down.

9. B — May you be well every year.
   كُلَّ عَامٍ وَأَنْتُمْ بِخَيْرٍ (kulla ʿaamin wa-antum bi-khayr) means: May you be well every year.

10. D — It makes a yes or no question
   hal begins a question that can be answered with naʿam or laa.

11. A — ashrabu
   ashrabu means I drink. aakulu means I eat and uhibbu means I like.

12. A — I drink milk.
   أَشْرَبُ الْحَلِيبَ (ashrabu l-haliiba) means: I drink milk.

13. A — I smell with my nose.
   أَشُمُّ بِأَنْفِي (ashummu bi-anfii) means: I smell with my nose.

14. B — asmaʿu bi-udhunii
   asmaʿu means I hear and udhun means ear.

15. B — أَنَا أَرَى بِعَيْنِي
   أَنَا أَرَى بِعَيْنِي (anaa araa biʿaynii) means: I see with my eye.

16. D — mushmis
   مُشْمِسٌ is read mushmis and means sunny.

17. D — sun
   شَمْسٌ (shams) means sun.

18. C — cold
   بَارِدٌ (baarid) means cold.

19. A — Thank you for listening.
   شُكْرًا لِاسْتِمَاعِكُمْ (shukran li-istimaaʿikum) means: Thank you for listening.

20. B — How your voice sounds, for example friendly and clear
   Tone is the sound quality of your voice, such as calm, friendly and clear.

SECTION B
----
21. (2 marks)
   Answer: I plant a tree.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

22. (2 marks)
   Answer: Practice helps the speaker to remember words, pronounce them correctly and feel less nervous.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for remembering or pronouncing and 1 mark for confidence.

23. (2 marks)
   Answer: I am at the door.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

24. (3 marks)
   Answer: Listen until the speaker finishes; do not speak at the same time; use polite words to interrupt; give others a chance.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each valid rule.

25. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example khubz (bread), aruzz (rice), dhura (maize), lahm (meat), samak (fish).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

26. (2 marks)
   Answer: I speak with my mouth.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

27. (2 marks)
   Answer: I am well, thanks be to God.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for the subject or first part and 1 mark for the rest of the meaning.

28. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example khubz (bread), samak (fish), mawz (bananas), maa' (water), haliib (milk).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with meaning.

29. (5 marks)
   Answer: For example shams (sun), sahaab (clouds), matar (rain), riih (wind), samaa' (sky).
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct word with its meaning.

30. (2 marks)
   Answer: In a statement the voice falls at the end. In a question it rises at the end.
   Working / marking points: 1 mark for each correct description.
